Container.Name: CrownJukebox
Container.Overview: CrownJukebox - Retro browser-based party jukebox. Frontend and backend in one container. Point it at your music folder and open it on a TV or touchscreen. Default internal port: 3000. The admin user is created in the first-run setup wizard.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the CrownJukebox web interface. Container port is 3000.

Config.Name: Music Library
Config.Description: Path to your music library on Unraid. Mounted read-only. Change this to match your server, for example /mnt/user/media/music.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Path where CrownJukebox stores its database and persistent app data.

Config.Name: Artwork Cache
Config.Description: Path where CrownJukebox stores cached album artwork.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Optional but recommended. Enter a long random secret for login/session signing. Do not publish your real secret in a public template. If left empty, CrownJukebox should generate or use its own persisted secret.

Config.Name: Session TTL Hours
Config.Description: Session timeout in hours. Default 168 = 7 days.

Config.Name: Subsonic URL
Config.Description: Optional. Set this if you use Subsonic/Navidrome, for example http://192.168.1.5:4533. Leave empty if unused.

Config.Name: Subsonic Username
Config.Description: Optional. Subsonic/Navidrome username, only used when SUBSONIC_URL is set.

Config.Name: Subsonic Password
Config.Description: Optional. Subsonic/Navidrome password, only used when SUBSONIC_URL is set.

Config.Name: Reset setup ved næste start
Config.Description: Valgfri ENGANGS-reset. Sæt til CONFIRM for at slette brugere/sessions og åbne setup-wizard igen (musikbibliotek bevares). VIGTIGT: fjern værdien igen efter opstart.
